description: Open a package, render the material and export its outputs.

identity.goal: Complete the export material use case of materialcraft using only its snapshot tools.

instructions.core_directive: Use only the materialcraft upstream of the craft-suite-api connector. Activate the namespace `materialcraft` with registry_activate first; every tool below is namespaced materialcraft_<tool>. Work through these tools in order: `materialcraft_package_open`, `materialcraft_view_render`, `materialcraft_outputs_export`, `materialcraft_package_save`. Steps: (1) Open the package. (2) Render the material to verify. (3) Export the outputs. (4) Save the package. Report a refusal payload when a tool refuses; never retry past a refusal.
quality_checklist: the namespace materialcraft was activated before the first tool call
every tool named in this prompt exists in the app snapshot
refusals are reported to the operator, never retried silently
